reviews.comment: [Sample] Asking each department head for sign-off on draft definitions before kickoff is a real test.
evidence: Written sign-off from each department head on draft definitions
Minutes from previous attempts to agree metrics

reviews.comment: “Check with IT” won't reveal data quality problems. Profile a sample of the actual data.
evidence: A profile of one month's data from each system: missing values, duplicates, mismatches
The number of manual adjustments made to last quarter's board figures

reviews.comment: Good to ask the CIO, but get a named person and dates, not a general yes.
evidence: IT's project roadmap for next quarter
A named integration lead with confirmed availability

overall: [Sample] The agreement risk is well covered. Data quality is the most dangerous assumption and your check wouldn't test it – fix that before relying on the timeline.
